entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.6.0** - **MANUAL page.** The plugin's manual is now on the MPC's screen: tap **MANUAL**, then the page buttons along the top (what it does, the controls, how it works with the other PotentialSuite plugins, and good-to-know notes). The full PotentialSuite manual is on the [PotentialSuite page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins). - One parameter was added at the end of the list (Manual Page); saved projects open as before. Sound and controls are unchanged.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.5.0** - **BROWSE page**: pick the exact break you want. It lists the breaks in the current library 10 at a time; tap a name to load it. **PAGE UP** / **PAGE DOWN** move through the list, **LIBRARY** switches folders without loading anything, and the break that's playing is lit. It opens on the page with the current break. - Two pages now: BREAKS (as before) and BROWSE. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.4.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.4.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random break played a random way. **MILD** chops it on the grid, in order. **MEDIUM** may also chop on the HITS, change the loop length, shuffle the pads and move the pitch a little. **WILD** shuffles every time, can switch the tempo mode and pitches up to 7 semitones either way. RANDOM BREAK still just picks a break. - **GRID chop now always cuts on the beat.** Before, a loop that wasn't 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars long was cut into 8 or 16 equal pieces

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.3.0** - **SAVE KIT**: one tap saves the 16 pads as a real **MPC drum program**: each pad as a WAV, as you hear it (at your tempo, pitch and shuffle), on pads A01-A16, with the groove as a MIDI file beside it. Load it like any program, and keep it after the plugin is gone. It goes to `PotentialBreaks/Kits` on your breaks' drive, or to the folder named on the first line of `PotentialBreaks/kit-folder.txt` there. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.4
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could load a random break. The MPC's host briefly "presses" a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was RANDOM BREAK. That first slot now does nothing; RANDOM BREAK is a new parameter at the end. The button works the same. - If you had automation or a Q-Link on RANDOM BREAK (unlikely), point it at the new **Random Break** parameter.
